beaches.name: Olympiaki Akti south
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported south of Olympiaki Akti towards the river mouth. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2016 and 2017 and calls the use long-standing; a second directory entry published in 2021 reports mostly male nude use about 1 km past the last houses. No designation is documented and the area is open to walkers.

beaches.name: Korinos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing between Paralia and Korinos is reported and contested. A naturist directory carries undated reports of nudism along this stretch, and a local news blog records that residents called a 'nudist beach' label on Google Maps illegal and had it removed in August 2017 after two years of complaints. No authority has designated the beach either way.
